verses.ar: تَرْنِيمَةُ ٱلْمَصَاعِدِ «كَثِيرًا مَا ضَايَقُونِي مُنْذُ شَبَابِي». لِيَقُلْ إِسْرَائِيلُ:
verses.kjv: A Song of degrees. Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
verses.web: A Song of Ascents. Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:
verses.he: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲלֹ֥ות רַ֭בַּת צְרָר֣וּנִי מִנְּעוּרַ֑י יֹֽאמַר־נָ֝א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

verses.ar: «كَثِيرًا مَا ضَايَقُونِي مُنْذُ شَبَابِي، لَكِنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرُوا عَلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.web: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.he: רַ֭בַּת צְרָר֣וּנִי מִנְּעוּרָ֑י גַּ֝ם לֹא־יָ֥כְלוּ לִֽי׃

verses.ar: عَلَى ظَهْرِي حَرَثَ ٱلْحُرَّاثُ. طَوَّلُوا أَتْلَامَهُمْ».
verses.kjv: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
verses.web: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.

verses.kjv: The LORD [is] righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
verses.web: Yahweh is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

verses.ar: فَلْيَخْزَ وَلْيَرْتَدَّ إِلَى ٱلْوَرَاءِ كُلُّ مُبْغِضِي صِهْيَوْنَ.
verses.kjv: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
verses.web: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
verses.he: יֵ֭בֹשׁוּ וְיִסֹּ֣גוּ אָחֹ֑ור כֹּ֝֗ל שֹׂנְאֵ֥י צִיֹּֽון׃

verses.ar: لِيَكُونُوا كَعُشْبِ ٱلسُّطُوحِ ٱلَّذِي يَيْبَسُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْلَعَ،
verses.kjv: Let them be as the grass [upon] the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
verses.web: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,
verses.he: יִ֭הְיוּ כַּחֲצִ֣יר גַּגֹּ֑ות שֶׁקַּדְמַ֖ת שָׁלַ֣ף יָבֵֽשׁ׃

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي لَا يَمْلَأُ ٱلْحَاصِدُ كَفَّهُ مِنْهُ وَلَا ٱلْمُحَزِّمُ حِضْنَهُ.
verses.kjv: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
verses.web: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.
verses.he: שֶׁלֹּ֤א מִלֵּ֖א כַפֹּ֥ו קֹוצֵ֗ר וְחִצְנֹ֥ו מְעַמֵּֽר׃

verses.ar: وَلَا يَقُولُ ٱلْعَابِرُونَ: «بَرَكَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ عَلَيْكُمْ. بَارَكْنَاكُمْ بِٱسْمِ ٱلرَّبِّ».
verses.kjv: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD [be] upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
verses.web: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of Yahweh be on you. We bless you in Yahweh’s name.”
verses.he: וְלֹ֤א אָֽמְר֨וּ ׀ הָעֹבְרִ֗ים בִּרְכַּֽת־יְהוָ֥ה אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם בֵּרַ֥כְנוּ אֶ֝תְכֶ֗ם בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃
